PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. When learning Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Data Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Safety.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Safety.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

6. When learning Plane Geometry, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plane Geometry.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plane Geometry.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plane Geometry.

7. When learning Plain Scale Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plain Scale Drawing.

8. When learning Ceramic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceramic Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceramic Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ceramic Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceramic Materials.

9. When learning Composite Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials.

10. When learning Dimensioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

11. When learning Fire Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fire Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fire Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fire Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fire Safety.

12. When learning Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
